description: Source code implementing a PackageManager plugin with classes for managing package operations, notifications, and plugin lifecycle within a Thunder framework environment.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package management, plugin lifecycle, and notification handling within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles notifications for dangling pointers and revocations related to package management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, registers notification callbacks.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters notifications and releases the service reference.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a JSON string.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Calls the underlying package manager to install a package.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Calls the underlying package manager to uninstall a package.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Calls the underlying package manager to download a package.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a package via the underlying package manager.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage details of a package.

methods.name: SetAuxMetadata
methods.description: Sets auxiliary metadata for a package.

methods.name: ClearAuxMetadata
methods.description: Clears auxiliary metadata for a package.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a package.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing package operation.

methods.name: GetProgress
methods.description: Gets progress of a package operation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification observer.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of installed packages.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for a reason.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a package.

methods.name: GetLockInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock information for a package.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers a package manager implementation to the plugin.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a previously offered package manager implementation.

methods.name: OperationStatusUpdate
methods.description: Handles status updates for package operations.

methods.name: OperationStatusNotification
methods.description: Notifies observers of package operation status.

methods.name: PackageManager
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the current package manager.

methods.name: Dangling
methods.description: Handles cleanup of dangling package manager pointers.
